# manifest (agent prose)

You are reading the bootstrap command index. This file declares which
command files exist, their phases, what triggers them, and the standard
execution order. It does not contain executable logic — it points at
the command YAMLs that do.

## Use this manifest to

- Discover which command to invoke for a given session phase
  (start, work, end)
- Verify the standard chain of execution
- Confirm the required schema for each command file

## Standard session flow

1. `session_start`
2. `bootstrap-start` (or `ingest` -> `audit` -> `init` manually)
3. `project_work_begins`
4. `bootstrap-checkpoint` (fires on events, manual any time, periodic
   self-check)
5. ... loop work + checkpoints ...
6. `session_end_signal`
7. `bootstrap-finalize`
8. `session_complete`

## Hard rules

- Never skip a phase. The session lifecycle is mandatory.
- Never invoke a command out of dependency order. Honor `invokes_after`
  and `invokes_before`.
- Never modify this manifest casually. It is the authoritative index of
  the bootstrap command set.
